title: Velo3D, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Velo3D, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 6, 2026 disclosing the appointment of James Suva as Chief Financial Officer, effective April 6, 2026. The filing details Mr. Suva's compensation terms including an annual base salary and equity grant. This is a routine corporate officer appointment disclosure with no market structure or macro catalyst content.
key_points: James Suva was appointed CFO and principal financial and accounting officer of Velo3D, Inc., effective April 6, 2026.
Mr. Suva's annual base salary is $380,000 with a target bonus of 70% of base salary for fiscal 2026.
The Compensation Committee approved a grant of 135,000 RSUs under the Company's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan with a grant date of April 6, 2026.
RSUs vest 25% on May 15, 2027, then 1/16th on each quarterly vest date thereafter.
The offer letter is at-will and contains customary confidentiality covenants.
